notes: Variant assumption: strict standing free-weight barbell overhead press from shoulder or clavicle height with no leg drive. Direct exact evidence is strongest for anterior deltoid and triceps brachii from Saeterbakken and Fimland's standing barbell shoulder press comparison. Pectoralis major is included as a secondary role from front barbell military press and overhead-press mechanics, not as the intended target. Serratus anterior support is backed by military-press and overhead-press evidence. Rotator cuff support is explicitly marked as a biomechanics inference from shoulder-elevation stability literature. Medial deltoid and upper trapezius appear important in the literature but are not shared anatomy entries in this project, so they were not added as visible roles. The generated data/movements.json bundle was intentionally not edited because this worker's write scope is limited to the two per-movement source files.
